text: 65分に、Seabrook Townが2-1と追いかけるために戦略を変えました。プレスの強さを大きく上げて、ボールを早く前に運ぶようにし、守備の位置も上げました[#1361]。けれども、その後のチャンスの期待値（xG）は少し下がり、シュート数も減ってしまいました。Harbour Cityは落ち着いて試合を支配し続けているようです[#1361]。

trace.output: Brief: Seabrook Town change approach for fan audience in ja

- Seabrook Town increased their press from 0.66 to 0.84 at 65' to chase the game [#1361]  
- They also raised their directness from 0.42 to 0.57 and line height from 0.6 to 0.72 [#1361]  
- After the change, Seabrook Town's xG fell from 0.61 to 0.43 despite higher possession (54.4%) [#1361]  
- Opponent xG remained stable around 0.11-0.12, with Seabrook Town trailing 1-2 at the change [#1361]  
- In last 10 minutes, Seabrook had 3 shots but zero on target and no big chances, showing limited attacking success

- Seabrook Town shifted to a higher pressing intensity (press increased from 0.66 to 0.84) and a more direct playing style (directness from 0.42 to 0.57), with a higher defensive line (line height from 0.6 to 0.72) to chase the game after being 2-1 down at 65' [#1361].
- This tactical change reflects an attempt by Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 formation, which naturally supports wide play and crossing, to speed up their attack and press aggressively higher up the pitch, in contrast to their prior approach favoring possession and build-up.
- However, the increased pressing led to a slight decline in some attacking metrics within the next 15 minutes, including lower xG (from 0.61 to 0.43) and fewer box touches (from 10 to 7), indicating that despite higher pressure and directness, Seabrook struggled to create quality chances against Harbour City’s patient short-passing 4-2-3-1 setup [#1361].
- Harbour City maintained effective control despite Seabrook’s more aggressive approach, demonstrated by reduced field tilt for Seabrook Town after the change (from 70.7% to 45.7%), suggesting Harbour’s compact shape limited the impact of Seabrook’s pressing and direct attacking efforts [#1361].
